title: FORMAT with "#,##0" has thousand separators and rounds to a whole number

source.quote: Standard use of the thousand separator is specified if the format contains a thousand separator surrounded by digit placeholders ( 0 or # ).
Digit placeholder. Display a digit or nothing.
source.supports: the # placeholder; the final 0 always shows a digit

source.quote: Consecutive commas not followed by 0 before the decimal point

derivation: 1234567 gets separators: "1,234,567". 1234.567 has no decimal placeholders, so it rounds to 1235: "1,235". 0 shows the one mandatory digit: "0".
